title: AI Cost & ROI - Azure AI Foundry
description: Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI token telemetry turned into cost and ROI. Token counts from Azure Monitor + a rate card = dollars. Set the data source and the App Insights resource ID variables.

list.name: resource
list.label: App Insights resource ID
list.description: Full resource ID of the Application Insights component your APIM gateway emits token metrics to.

azureLogAnalytics.query: let rates=datatable(family:string,inK:real,outK:real)["gpt-5.x",0.00125,0.010,"gpt-4o",0.0025,0.010,"gpt-4o-mini",0.00015,0.0006,"o-series",0.0011,0.0044]; let base=customMetrics | where name in ("Prompt Tokens","Completion Tokens") | extend dep=tostring(customDimensions.ModelDeploymentName) | extend family=case(dep has "gpt-4o-mini","gpt-4o-mini",dep has "gpt-4o","gpt-4o",dep has "gpt-5","gpt-5.x",dep has_any("o1","o3","o4"),"o-series","gpt-4o") | summarize inTok=sumif(valueSum,name=="Prompt Tokens"),outTok=sumif(valueSum,name=="Completion Tokens") by family,bin(timestamp,1d) | lookup kind=leftouter rates on family | extend costUsd=(inTok/1000.0*coalesce(inK,0.0))+(outTok/1000.0*coalesce(outK,0.0)); base | where timestamp>=startofmonth(now()) | summarize Value=round(sum(costUsd),0)

let rates=datatable(family:string,inK:real,outK:real)["gpt-5.x",0.00125,0.010,"gpt-4o",0.0025,0.010,"gpt-4o-mini",0.00015,0.0006,"o-series",0.0011,0.0044]; let base=customMetrics | where name in ("Prompt Tokens","Completion Tokens") | extend dep=tostring(customDimensions.ModelDeploymentName) | extend family=case(dep has "gpt-4o-mini","gpt-4o-mini",dep has "gpt-4o","gpt-4o",dep has "gpt-5","gpt-5.x",dep has_any("o1","o3","o4"),"o-series","gpt-4o") | summarize inTok=sumif(valueSum,name=="Prompt Tokens"),outTok=sumif(valueSum,name=="Completion Tokens") by family,bin(timestamp,1d) | lookup kind=leftouter rates on family | extend costUsd=(inTok/1000.0*coalesce(inK,0.0))+(outTok/1000.0*coalesce(outK,0.0)); let mtd=toscalar(base | where timestamp>=startofmonth(now()) | summarize sum(costUsd)); print Value=round(mtd/toreal(datetime_part("day",now()))*toreal(datetime_part("day",endofmonth(now()))),0)

let rates=datatable(family:string,inK:real,outK:real)["gpt-5.x",0.00125,0.010,"gpt-4o",0.0025,0.010,"gpt-4o-mini",0.00015,0.0006,"o-series",0.0011,0.0044]; let base=customMetrics | where name in ("Prompt Tokens","Completion Tokens") | extend dep=tostring(customDimensions.ModelDeploymentName) | extend family=case(dep has "gpt-4o-mini","gpt-4o-mini",dep has "gpt-4o","gpt-4o",dep has "gpt-5","gpt-5.x",dep has_any("o1","o3","o4"),"o-series","gpt-4o") | summarize inTok=sumif(valueSum,name=="Prompt Tokens"),outTok=sumif(valueSum,name=="Completion Tokens") by family,bin(timestamp,1d) | lookup kind=leftouter rates on family | extend costUsd=(inTok/1000.0*coalesce(inK,0.0))+(outTok/1000.0*coalesce(outK,0.0)); base | summarize c=sum(costUsd),t=sum(inTok+outTok) | project Value=round(c/(t/1000.0),4)
customMetrics | where name in ("Prompt Tokens","Cached Tokens") | summarize p=sumif(valueSum,name=="Prompt Tokens"),c=sumif(valueSum,name=="Cached Tokens") | project Value=round(100.0*c/p,1)

let rates=datatable(family:string,inK:real,outK:real)["gpt-5.x",0.00125,0.010,"gpt-4o",0.0025,0.010,"gpt-4o-mini",0.00015,0.0006,"o-series",0.0011,0.0044]; let base=customMetrics | where name in ("Prompt Tokens","Completion Tokens") | extend dep=tostring(customDimensions.ModelDeploymentName) | extend family=case(dep has "gpt-4o-mini","gpt-4o-mini",dep has "gpt-4o","gpt-4o",dep has "gpt-5","gpt-5.x",dep has_any("o1","o3","o4"),"o-series","gpt-4o") | summarize inTok=sumif(valueSum,name=="Prompt Tokens"),outTok=sumif(valueSum,name=="Completion Tokens") by family,bin(timestamp,1d) | lookup kind=leftouter rates on family | extend costUsd=(inTok/1000.0*coalesce(inK,0.0))+(outTok/1000.0*coalesce(outK,0.0)); base | make-series DailyCostUsd=sum(costUsd) default=0 on timestamp from startofday(ago(30d)) to startofday(now()) step 1d | mv-expand timestamp to typeof(datetime), DailyCostUsd to typeof(real) | project timestamp, DailyCostUsd=round(DailyCostUsd,2)

let rates=datatable(family:string,inK:real,outK:real)["gpt-5.x",0.00125,0.010,"gpt-4o",0.0025,0.010,"gpt-4o-mini",0.00015,0.0006,"o-series",0.0011,0.0044]; customMetrics | where name in ("Prompt Tokens","Completion Tokens") | where timestamp>=startofmonth(now()) | extend dep=tostring(customDimensions.ModelDeploymentName) | extend family=case(dep has "gpt-4o-mini","gpt-4o-mini",dep has "gpt-4o","gpt-4o",dep has "gpt-5","gpt-5.x",dep has_any("o1","o3","o4"),"o-series","gpt-4o") | summarize inTok=sumif(valueSum,name=="Prompt Tokens"),outTok=sumif(valueSum,name=="Completion Tokens") by family | lookup kind=leftouter rates on family | extend CostUsd=round((inTok/1000.0*coalesce(inK,0.0))+(outTok/1000.0*coalesce(outK,0.0)),2) | project family, CostUsd | order by CostUsd desc

panels.title: Token volume by type (Input / Output / Cached)

azureLogAnalytics.query: customMetrics | where name in ("Prompt Tokens","Completion Tokens","Cached Tokens") | extend TokenType=case(name=="Prompt Tokens","Input",name=="Completion Tokens","Output","Cached") | summarize Tokens=sum(valueSum) by TokenType, bin(timestamp,1d) | evaluate pivot(TokenType, sum(Tokens))

let hoursSaved=1240.0; let loadedRate=74.0; let rates=datatable(family:string,inK:real,outK:real)["gpt-5.x",0.00125,0.010,"gpt-4o",0.0025,0.010,"gpt-4o-mini",0.00015,0.0006,"o-series",0.0011,0.0044]; let base=customMetrics | where name in ("Prompt Tokens","Completion Tokens") | where timestamp>=startofmonth(now()) | extend dep=tostring(customDimensions.ModelDeploymentName) | extend family=case(dep has "gpt-4o-mini","gpt-4o-mini",dep has "gpt-4o","gpt-4o",dep has "gpt-5","gpt-5.x",dep has_any("o1","o3","o4"),"o-series","gpt-4o") | summarize inTok=sumif(valueSum,name=="Prompt Tokens"),outTok=sumif(valueSum,name=="Completion Tokens") by family | lookup kind=leftouter rates on family | extend costUsd=(inTok/1000.0*coalesce(inK,0.0))+(outTok/1000.0*coalesce(outK,0.0)); let agentCost=toscalar(base | summarize sum(costUsd)); print Value=round(100.0*(hoursSaved*loadedRate-agentCost)/max_of(agentCost,1.0),0)

panels.title: Business value / ROI (edit hoursSaved and loadedRate in the query)

azureLogAnalytics.query: let hoursSaved=1240.0; let loadedRate=74.0; let rates=datatable(family:string,inK:real,outK:real)["gpt-5.x",0.00125,0.010,"gpt-4o",0.0025,0.010,"gpt-4o-mini",0.00015,0.0006,"o-series",0.0011,0.0044]; let base=customMetrics | where name in ("Prompt Tokens","Completion Tokens") | where timestamp>=startofmonth(now()) | extend dep=tostring(customDimensions.ModelDeploymentName) | extend family=case(dep has "gpt-4o-mini","gpt-4o-mini",dep has "gpt-4o","gpt-4o",dep has "gpt-5","gpt-5.x",dep has_any("o1","o3","o4"),"o-series","gpt-4o") | summarize inTok=sumif(valueSum,name=="Prompt Tokens"),outTok=sumif(valueSum,name=="Completion Tokens") by family | lookup kind=leftouter rates on family | extend costUsd=(inTok/1000.0*coalesce(inK,0.0))+(outTok/1000.0*coalesce(outK,0.0)); let valueOfTime=hoursSaved*loadedRate; let agentCost=toscalar(base | summarize sum(costUsd)); print ord=1,Metric="Hours saved / period",Value=tostring(hoursSaved) | union (print ord=2,Metric="Value of time saved",Value=strcat("$",tostring(round(valueOfTime,0)))) | union (print ord=3,Metric="Agent run cost",Value=strcat("$",tostring(round(agentCost,0)))) | union (print ord=4,Metric="Payback (share of period)",Value=iff(valueOfTime<=0,"n/a",tostring(round(agentCost/valueOfTime,2)))) | order by ord asc | project Metric, Value
